references.claim: Absolute linker path is checked with can_execute before accepting it; rejection emits invalid-linker diagnostic then falls back to general program lookup.
Upstream executable eligibility uses access(R_OK|X_OK), then stat and regular-file checks.
Program lookup tests executable eligibility through prefixes/program paths and returns an unresolved name if none qualifies.
Upstream Darwin linker job selects its executable through GetLinkerPath.
Published Darwin access path consults MAC policy before ordinary vnode authorization.
Executable-access request is passed to the MAC policy hook; actual proprietary Seatbelt mapping remains unproved.
